ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Districts
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.1.0 (Expansion Pack)
An expansion pack for Regions and Societies. It simulates the inside of a world tile.
Core divides the planet into regions and gives each one a population. This adds the layer underneath: every settlement is a cluster of districts, each district is one local map of ground, and each district is a place in its own right with its own people and its own job.
Features: - Districts as real places: a settlement is a hex cluster of 1 to 61 local maps, and you can see which is which. - Enclaves: xenotypes and wealth cluster by district instead of averaging across the whole region, so a city has quarters. - A living skyline: settlements build districts one at a time as they grow, and empty districts fall to ruin when people leave. - Each district does one job - farming, forestry, mining, quarrying, manufacturing, trade, garrison, or no specialty at all - and what the settlement produces is the sum of them. - Special structures that change what a district is worth to its settlement. - Unrest that accumulates where people are repressed, crowded or occupied, published for other mods to act on.
Requires: Regions and Societies (either the standard or the Realistic Planets 2 edition). Core supplies the geometry and the economic sector vocabulary this reads; everything above is added here.
